description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Coral Trickster, adding {U}.
When Coral Trickster dies, Yedora triggers, returning Coral Trickster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Coral Trickster by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Coral Trickster's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Coral Trickster triggers, tapping or untapping target permanent.
Repeat.
